game.name: Knights Contract (USA)
game.desc: Knights Contract is a beat'em all for Xbox 360. You play as Heinrich, an invulnerable hero, who must constantly watch Gretchen, the witch who accompanies him. Knights Contract allows you to use both Heinrich's scythe and Gretchen's magical powers. Try to take advantage of your companion by giving her instructions and don't leave her in a bad situation to avoid game over.
